kinds.a: photo file · RAW file · JPEG · PNG
kinds.d: A photograph or pixel image held as a file, whether camera raw, lossy compressed or lossless.
t: camera raw (DNG, CR2/CR3 Canon, NEF Nikon, ARW Sony, RAF Fujifilm, ORF Olympus, RW2 Panasonic, PEF Pentax, RWL Leica, 3FR Hasselblad, IIQ Phase One, X3F Sigma, GPR GoPro, ARI ARRI)

kinds.d: An image file that stays editable, either as separate raster layers or as scalable shapes and paths.

notes: Restraint-only. Camera raw photo, JPEG-type photo file and Lossless image file merged into Digital photo or image; the per-maker raw formats and the format 'models' became type detail per brief. Layered image file and Vector graphic file merged into Editable graphics file with two types. Both kinds cite the merged kinds' old source (Comparison of graphics file formats). HEIC is named in the brief's lossy type but was not an old model.
